_note: Demo day: one operator flying the project's T1 10 L quad (2 packs, 1 charger) near Dankaur, Uttar Pradesh, India (India drone-SOP rule pack). Pins are approximate village centres; in use they come from the farmer's location pin. spray_ha = area a FieldPilot scan + crop twin justified; absent = not scanned, whole field.

messages.text: Didi namaste, Ramesh bol raha hoon Dankaur se. 2 acre aalu hai, patton pe kaale dhabbe aa rahe hain, jhulsa lag raha hai. Kal subah spray kar do.
रबूपुरा से सुनीता बोल रही हूँ। सरसों 2 बीघा है, माहू लग गया है। कल आ जाना।
Jewar, Mahesh here. 3 acre potato, late blight started. Mancozeb main le aaunga.
Dadri se Kamla Devi. Gehun 1.5 acre mein kharpatwar bahut hai, jaldi karna, parso paani lagana hai.
Bilaspur se Imran. Aalu 4 acre, jhulsa shuru ho gaya hai.
झाझर से गीता। ढाई बीघा आलू, पत्ते सूख रहे हैं।
Vikram, Atta gaon. 2.5 acre sarson me spray chahiye is hafte.
